name: pm-skills
description: Reliability-first PM operating system with 86 domain-specific skills and 51 chained workflows across 11 PM plugins — discovery, strategy, business cases, execution, market intelligence, GTM, enterprise transformation, automation, analytics, growth, and AI shipping.

plugins.name: pm-product-discovery
plugins.description: Product discovery skills for PMs: ideation, experiments, assumption testing, feature prioritization, and customer interview synthesis.

plugins.name: pm-product-strategy
plugins.description: Product strategy skills for PMs: vision, strategy canvas, value propositions, lean canvas, business model canvas, SWOT, PESTLE, Ansoff Matrix, Porter's Five Forces, and monetization.

plugins.name: pm-execution
plugins.description: Execution and product management skills: PRDs, OKRs, roadmaps, sprints, pre-mortems, stakeholder maps, user stories, prioritization frameworks, and more.

plugins.name: pm-market-research
plugins.description: Reliability-first market research: personas, segmentation, market sizing, sentiment, competitor analysis, evidence discipline, search exhaustion, and contradiction passes.

plugins.name: pm-data-analytics
plugins.description: Data analytics skills for PMs: SQL, cohort analysis, and experiment analysis with statistical and decision-quality safeguards.

plugins.name: pm-go-to-market
plugins.description: Go-to-market skills for PMs: enterprise GTM, growth loops, motions, beachhead segments, ICPs, and evidence-backed competitive battlecards.

plugins.name: pm-marketing-growth
plugins.description: Product marketing and growth skills: marketing ideas, value propositions, North Star metrics, product naming, and positioning.

plugins.name: pm-toolkit
plugins.description: PM utility skills: resume review, NDA drafting, privacy policy generation, and grammar/flow checking.

plugins.name: pm-ai-shipping
plugins.description: AI Shipping Kit — document AI-built apps, audit intended-vs-implemented gaps, derive tests, and produce reviewer-ready shipping evidence.

plugins.name: pm-enterprise-transformation
plugins.description: Enterprise transformation workflows for future capability building, client-proof-to-GTM, sales transformation, and PM/tooling automation with evidence, economics, and governance gates.

plugins.name: pm-business-case
plugins.description: Reliability-first business case formation with claim-level evidence, market and customer proof, reconstructable economics, commercialization, falsification, adversarial review, and gated investment decisions.
